name: The Bleeding Stranger in the Alley
summary: Curled at the end of the alley, drenched in blood yet still breathing. Identity undecided — perhaps a robbed traveler, perhaps one of your own kind who can also smell blood, perhaps bait the witch-hunter set for whatever comes to it. To save, to question, or to drain — each has its price.

identity_states.victim: Truly just a robbed wretch — saving earns a good name; draining leaves a corpse and rumors
identity_states.kin: Another ageless / night-walker — an ally, or a rival for the same prey
identity_states.bait: The inquisitor's trap — approach and you are 'witnessed'; suspicion spikes, inquisitor_alerted

note: Identity is undecided at start; the world-agent fixes it from the player's recent behavior and current suspicion.
